title: psychotria andetrensis
intro: Psychotria andetrensis, commonly known as the Andeana Wild Coffee or Mountain Coffee, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a medicinal plant native to the Andes mountain range in South America, used for centuries by indigenous communities to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Psychotria andetrensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
